apiKeys.description: Every key on this instance. A key can only ever do what its owner can, and instance-wide keys carry management permissions.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains users can put their routes under. HTTP ports become Pangolin resources, TCP ports get a Cloudflare SRV record — the Cloudflare zone is looked up by domain name when you add it. A private domain is only offered to the projects you grant it to.
domains.backendNotConfigured: Neither route backend is configured. Add <code1>[routes.cloudflare]</code1> for TCP routes (SRV records) or <code2>[routes.pangolin]</code2> for HTTP routes to the backend config.

createDialog.title: New domain
createDialog.description: Routes are created as subdomains of this domain.
createDialog.pangolinIdHelp: The domain's ID in Pangolin. Required for HTTP routes; TCP routes go through Cloudflare, whose zone is resolved from the domain name.
createDialog.httpsHelp: Users may enable HTTPS for HTTP routes on this domain.
createDialog.privateHelp: Only granted projects see this domain.

grantDialog.title: Grant project access
grantDialog.description: Pick the project that may use {{domain}}.

deleteDialog.title: Delete domain
deleteDialog.description: {{domain}} can no longer be used for new routes. A domain that still has routes cannot be deleted.

notFound.description: This page doesn't exist or you don't have access to it.

projects.description: Browse projects available to the current admin session.
projects.searchPlaceholder: Search by project, slug, or owner...

regions.description: Group nodes by location. Every node belongs to exactly one region.

emptyState.title: No regions found

deleteDialog.title: Delete region
deleteDialog.description: "{{display}}" will be removed permanently. Nodes must be moved to another region first.

formDialog.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
